name: Bug fix
purpose: Fix a reproducible defect with the smallest safe change and prove it with a regression test.
trigger: A defect is triaged by support or QA and recorded with a severity below Sev1.
entry_criteria: Defect recorded with severity, affected version and steps from L1/L2 support
No active Sev1 incident (otherwise use emergency-hotfix)

steps.note: Reproduce and isolate; write the failing test first.
Confirm the new test fails on the old code and passes on the fix.

decisions.question: Did the production smoke test pass?

failure_paths.condition: Not reproducible after two attempts with the reporter's data
failure_paths.action: Mark the defect NEEDS_INFO, return it to L2 support with what was tried
Return to 170; do not weaken or skip the failing test
Return to 170 with the staging evidence attached

exit_criteria: Failing test from step 169 is in the suite and passes on the release commit
Regression suite passes on the merge commit
Production smoke test passes for the released artifact version
Defect closed with link to the PR and release
communication_plan: Update the reporter after reproduction (169) and after release (139); post in the support channel when the fix ships.
